independent_acceptance.source_and_quantifiers: Checked the unit, conductor, beta valuation, field-extension and prime-construction assumptions on source pages 4-5 and 7-9. F=Q(zeta_3), K=F(i), ell=3 is allowed after the stated cyclotomic base change.
independent_acceptance.decisive_reasoning: At the dyadic place F is unramified of residue degree 2, the quadratic extension has conductor exponent 2, beta has valuation 1, and the required coordinates are units. The printed congruence t1=t3 mod 2 makes both x-z and x+z divisible by 2, hence x^2-z^2 divisible by 4, contradicting valuation 1. Thus the printed local construction fails under its own hypotheses.
independent_acceptance.repair_check: Checked the report's ramified quadratic-character repair in the cases c<=e, c=e+1 and c>=e+2: the specified unit-depth adjustments respectively control the two required characters without undoing the other constraint; in the middle case residue size at least 4 supplies a nonzero kernel element. At odd ramified primes Q>=7, the conic has enough points after excluding at most four forbidden coordinates. The global CRT sign choice produces the required product -1.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_impact: A valid replacement local construction prevents inference that the main theorem is false. The existing source derivation nevertheless fails at a core prime-construction step; the report's distinction between proof defect and theorem falsity is retained.

problems.title: The singular-series local count lacks its residue-volume normalization

labels: Proposition3.1 proof, displayed finite singular series

problems.claim: Displayed q/(q-1)^3 limit of unnormalized unit-pair counts modulo p^n gives local singular-series factor.
assumptions_checked: Count two free residue coordinates modulo p^n
problems.check: Count=(q-1)(q-2)q^(2(n-1)), so displayed limitdiverges. Forq7 outputs35/36,1715/36,84035/36; correctedconstant35/36.
problems.result: Displayed expression is not a finite local density.
problems.counterevidence: Independent Kai affine-prime-pattern theorem applies after parameterizing W as a coset; neither localdensity display nor subgroup wording refutesProposition3.1.
problems.impact: Local calculation defect without demonstrated central failure of the prime-triple existence theorem.
problems.correction: Multiplycount byq^(-2(n-1)) inprintedform, equivalently useq^(-2n)/(1-q^-1)^3. Gives1-1/(q-1)^2 awaybeta andq/(q-1) atp|beta.

independent_acceptance.decisive_reasoning: For the stated good-prime congruence the unnormalized count is (Q-1)(Q-2)Q^(2(j-1)); multiplication by the printed fixed Q/(Q-1)^3 diverges. Inserting Q^(-2j)/(1-Q^(-1))^3 gives 1-1/(Q-1)^2; the p|beta factor becomes Q/(Q-1).
independent_acceptance.repair_and_counterevidence: The source expressly supplies an alternative affine-linear-form prime theorem route. Its external hypothesis interface is retained, not independently reproved. The missing normalization does not independently refute the prime-existence result, supporting Minor.

This is completion/counterevidence, not an additional reported defect.
